crossRefs.note: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
When it was day, some of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither…
asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem; plotting to kill him on the way.
Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God…
If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were…
I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles…
Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria…
When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship…
Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go…
In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
translations.bsb: where he stayed three months. And when the Jews formed a plot against him as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.
translations.kjv: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
translations.asv: And when he had spent three months there, and a plot was laid against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
